title: Revealing third-order interactions through the integration of machine learning and entropy methods in genomic studies.
summary: The paper uses learned RF ranking plus entropy to infer specific third-order genetic interactions and candidate AD biomarker loci from named disease datasets, a concrete computational genomic result; candidate status and no independent biological verification remain explicit. AI role: Random-forest feature ranking combined with entropy methods. The article appeared in Biodata Mining.
